name: TradeSim
summary: A full-stack trading simulation platform that allows users to simulate stock trading, track portfolios and analyse market data through an interactive dashboard.

name: Image Classifier
summary: A custom convolutional neural network built with Python and PyTorch to classify images from the CIFAR-10 dataset, achieving 92.8% training accuracy and 88.5% test accuracy.

name: Tenzies Game
summary: A responsive Tenzies dice game built with React and JavaScript, featuring dice selection, hold mechanics, win detection, keyboard accessibility and animated victory feedback.
